translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Kuomi ema aseponde, yaye Jehova Nyasaye;
kik iwe ayud wichkuot.
Konya kendo gola e chandruok, nikech timni makare;
winja kendo iresa.
Bedna lwanda mar pondo,
ma anyalo ringo adhiye seche duto;
gol chik mondo iresa,
nimar in e lwandana kendo ohingana.
Resa e lwet joma timbegi richo, yaye Nyasacha,
gola kuom richo gi joma kwiny momaka matek.
Nimar in ema isebedo genona, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto,
in ema isebedo kimiya chir nyaka ae tin-na.
Asebedo ka ayiengora kuomi nyaka ne nywola;
in ema ne igola ei minwa.
Abiro apaki nyaka chiengʼ.
Alokora gima bwogo ji mangʼeny
to kata kamano in e kar pondo mara motegno.
Dhoga opongʼ gi pakni,
kendo asiko ahulo duongʼni maler odiechiengʼ duto.
Kik ijog koda ka koro ati;
kik ijwangʼa ka tekra orumo.
Nimar wasika wuoyo marach kuoma;
jogo marita mondo onega loso wach kaachiel.
Giwacho niya, “Nyasaye oseweye;
laweuru mondo umake,
nikech onge ngʼama biro rese.”
Kik ibed mabor koda, yaye Nyasaye;
bi piyo mondo ikonya, yaye Nyasacha.
Mad joma donjona lal nono ka wigi okuot;
mad joma dwaro hinya,
obed gi achaya kod wichkuot koni gi koni.
Anto abiro siko ka an gi geno;
abiro paki kendo abiro medo paki.
Dhoga biro hulo timni makare,
kod warruokni odiechiengʼ duto,
kata obedo ni gingʼeny mohinga ngʼeyo.
Abiro biro mondo anyis ji timbeni madongo,
yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto;
abiro nyiso ji timni makare, timni makare in kendi.
Isepuonja nyaka aa e nyathi, yaye Nyasaye,
kendo nyaka kawuono pod ahulo timbe miwuoro.
Kata ka ochopo kinde ma ati kendo wiya oselokore lwar,
to kik iweya, yaye Nyasaye,
nyaka ahul tekoni ni tienge mabiro,
kendo ahul timbeni madongo ni tienge duto mabiro.
Timni makare ochopo nyaka ei kor polo, yaye Nyasaye,
in misetimo gik madongo.
En ngʼa ma dipim kodi, yaye Nyasaye?
Kata obedo ni isemiyo aneno chandruok mathoth kendo malit,
to pod ibiro miyo abed mangima kendo.
Ibiro gola e bur matut
mi achak abed gi duongʼ.
Ibiro miyo duongʼ ma an-go medore
kendo ibiro chako ihoya kendo.
Abiro paki gi nyatiti
nikech adiera mari, yaye Nyasaye;
abiro weroni wend pak gi orutu,
yaye Nyasaye Maler mar Israel.
Abiro kok gi mor
ka aweroni wend pak,
nikech an ngʼat misewaro.
Dhoga biro nyiso ji kuom timbeni makare
odiechiengʼ duto,
nimar joma ne dwaro hinya
oseneno wichkuot kendo osengʼengʼ.
